language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, i am Chip!
Hi, my name is Allan.
My father is a truck driver. He gets to see all of the land in his big truck.
He ships the food and all of the other things you can see at the grocery store.
So today, he is taking me for a ride. We sat with my father’s friend at his truck scale.
He reads the weights of each truck as they drive up.
You can tell how full a truck is by how much it weighs and compare the weight to the capacity painted on the side of the truck.
For example, this big blue truck weighs 10 metric tons.
But on the side, it has capacity 20 metric tons. Which means that it is 1/2 full.
Right behind the blue truck was a smaller green truck.
I got a chance to read the scale and it said that it weighs 4 metric tons.
Then I looked that the capacity on the side of the truck. It said 6 metric tons.
So how full is it?
I said, it’s 4 divided by 6 which is 2/3 rds full.
The man said, you really catch on quick.
